surah.personality_title: Surah Al-Qamar (The Cleaving of the Moon & The Rhythm of Remembrance)
surah.personality_summary: Autonomous Qur'anic surah possessing a distinctive theological axis, spiritual atmosphere, and structural cadence.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Opens with the splitting of the moon and rejection by transgressors, and concludes with the righteous resting securely in seats of truth in the presence of an Omnipotent Sovereign (54:54-55).
surah.overview: Surah Al-Qamar (The Moon) is the 54th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 55 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱقۡتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ اقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The Hour draws near; the moon is split in two

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةࣰ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرࣱ مُّسۡتَمِرࣱّ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِنْ يَرَوْا آيَةً يُعْرِضُوا وَيَقُولُوا سِحْرٌ مُسْتَمِرٌّ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وان يروا اية يعرضوا ويقولوا سحر مستمر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Whenever the disbelievers see a sign, they turn away and say, ‘Same old sorcery!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرࣲ مُّسۡتَقِرࣱّ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَكَذَّبُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُسْتَقِرٌّ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وكذبوا واتبعوا اهواءهم ۚ وكل امر مستقر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They reject the truth and follow their own desires––everything is recorded––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَنْبَاءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد جاءهم من الانباء ما فيه مزدجر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: although warning tales that should have restrained them have come down to them––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: حِكۡمَةُۢ بَٰلِغَةࣱۖ فَمَا تُغۡنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: حِكْمَةٌ بَالِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ النُّذُرُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: حكمة بالغة ۖ فما تغن النذر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: farreaching wisdom––but these warnings do not help

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءࣲ نُّكُرٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ الدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيْءٍ نُكُرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فتول عنهم ۘ يوم يدع الداع الى شيء نكر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so [Prophet] turn away from them. On the Day the Summoner will summon them to a horrific event

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادࣱ مُّنتَشِرࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَارُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُنْتَشِرٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: خشعا ابصارهم يخرجون من الاجداث كانهم جراد منتشر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: eyes downcast, they will come out of their graves like swarming locusts

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: مُهْطِعِينَ إِلَى الدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ الْكَافِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: مهطعين الى الداع ۖ يقول الكافرون هذا يوم عسر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: rushing towards the Summoner. The disbelievers will cry, ‘This is a stern day!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ۞كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجۡنُونࣱ وَٱزۡدُجِرَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا مَجْنُونٌ وَازْدُجِرَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ۞ كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح فكذبوا عبدنا وقالوا مجنون وازدجر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The people of Noah rejected the truth before them: they rejected Our servant, saying, ‘He is mad!’ Noah was rebuked

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبࣱ فَٱنتَصِرۡ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانْتَصِرْ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فدعا ربه اني مغلوب فانتصر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and so he called upon his Lord, ‘I am defeated: help me!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءࣲ مُّنۡهَمِرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَفَتَحْنَا أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَاءٍ مُنْهَمِرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ففتحنا ابواب السماء بماء منهمر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So We opened the gates of the sky with torrential water

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَفَجَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ عُيُونࣰ ا فَٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرࣲ قَدۡ قُدِرَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَفَجَّرْنَا الْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَالْتَقَى الْمَاءُ عَلَىٰ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وفجرنا الارض عيونا فالتقى الماء على امر قد قدر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: burst the earth with gushing springs: the waters met for a preordained purpose

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَحَمَلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلۡوَٰحࣲ وَدُسُرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَحَمَلْنَاهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَاحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وحملناه على ذات الواح ودسر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We carried him along on a vessel of planks and nails

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءࣰ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: تَجْرِي بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَاءً لِمَنْ كَانَ كُفِرَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: تجري باعيننا جزاء لمن كان كفر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that floated under Our watchful eye, a reward for the one who had been rejected

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةࣰ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ تَرَكْنَاهَا آيَةً فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد تركناها اية فهل من مدكر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have left this as a sign: will anyone take heed

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد يسرنا القران للذكر فهل من مدكر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادࣱ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كذبت عاد فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The people of 'Ad also rejected the truth. How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحࣰ ا صَرۡصَرࣰ ا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسࣲ مُّسۡتَمِرࣲّ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُسْتَمِرٍّ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا ارسلنا عليهم ريحا صرصرا في يوم نحس مستمر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We released a howling wind against them on a day of terrible disaster

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلࣲ مُّنقَعِرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: تَنْزِعُ النَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُنْقَعِرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: تنزع الناس كانهم اعجاز نخل منقعر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: it swept people away like uprooted palm trunks

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد يسرنا القران للذكر فهل من مدكر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كذبت ثمود بالنذر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Thamud denied the warning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The people of Thamud also rejected the warnings

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرࣰ ا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدࣰ ا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذࣰ ا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلࣲ وَسُعُرٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَقَالُوا أَبَشَرًا مِنَّا وَاحِدًا نَتَّبِعُهُ إِنَّا إِذًا لَفِي ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فقالوا ابشرا منا واحدا نتبعه انا اذا لفي ضلال وسعر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they said, ‘What? A man? Why should we follow a lone man from amongst ourselves? That would be misguided; quite insane

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَأُلْقِيَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: االقي الذكر عليه من بيننا بل هو كذاب اشر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Would a mes-sage be given to him alone out of all of us? No, he is an insolent liar!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: سَيَعۡلَمُونَ غَدࣰ ا مَّنِ ٱلۡكَذَّابُ ٱلۡأَشِرُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَنِ الْكَذَّابُ الْأَشِرُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: سيعلمون غدا من الكذاب الاشر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is the insolent liar

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةࣰ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُو النَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَهُمْ فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ وَاصْطَبِرْ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا مرسلو الناقة فتنة لهم فارتقبهم واصطبر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for We shall send them a she-camel to test them: so watch them [Salih] and be patient

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبࣲ مُّحۡتَضَرࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ الْمَاءَ قِسْمَةٌ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُحْتَضَرٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ونبئهم ان الماء قسمة بينهم ۖ كل شرب محتضر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Tell them the water is to be shared between them: each one should drink in turn.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَنَادَوْا صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فنادوا صاحبهم فتعاطى فعقر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But they called their companion, who took a sword and hamstrung the camel

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فكيف كان عذابي ونذر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَكَانُوا كَهَشِيمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا ارسلنا عليهم صيحة واحدة فكانوا كهشيم المحتظر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We released a single mighty blast against them and they ended up like a fencemaker’s dry sticks

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد يسرنا القران للذكر فهل من مدكر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ بِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كذبت قوم لوط بالنذر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The people of Lot denied the warning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The people of Lot rejected the warnings

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطࣲۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّا آلَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَجَّيْنَاهُمْ بِسَحَرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا ارسلنا عليهم حاصبا الا ال لوط ۖ نجيناهم بسحر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We released a stonebearing wind against them, all except the family of Lot. We saved them before dawn

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: نِّعۡمَةࣰ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: نِعْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي مَنْ شَكَرَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: نعمة من عندنا ۚ كذلك نجزي من شكر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: as a favour from Us: this is how We reward the thankful

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ أَنْذَرَهُمْ بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا بِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد انذرهم بطشتنا فتماروا بالنذر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warning

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدُوهُ عَنْ ضَيْفِهِ فَطَمَسْنَا أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد راودوه عن ضيفه فطمسنا اعينهم فذوقوا عذابي ونذر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they even demanded his guests from him- so We sealed their eyes- ‘ Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابࣱ مُّسۡتَقِرࣱّ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُمْ بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُسْتَقِرٌّ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد صبحهم بكرة عذاب مستقر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and early in the morning a punishment seized them that still remains

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَذُوقُوا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فذوقوا عذابي ونذر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So taste My punishment and warning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد يسرنا القران للذكر فهل من مدكر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَ آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ النُّذُرُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد جاء ال فرعون النذر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The people of Pharaoh also received warnings

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزࣲ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كذبوا باياتنا كلها فاخذناهم اخذ عزيز مقتدر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They rejected all Our signs so We seized them with all Our might and power

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةࣱ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أُولَٰئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُمْ بَرَاءَةٌ فِي الزُّبُرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اكفاركم خير من اولئكم ام لكم براءة في الزبر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Are your disbelievers any better than these? Were you given an exemption in the Scripture?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعࣱ مُّنتَصِرࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُنْتَصِرٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام يقولون نحن جميع منتصر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do they perhaps say, ‘We are a great army and we shall be victorious’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: سيهزم الجمع ويولون الدبر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Their forces will be routed and they will turn tail and flee

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
ayahs.arabic_simple: بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بل الساعة موعدهم والساعة ادهى وامر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But the Hour is their appointed time- the Hour is more severe and bitter

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ وَسُعُرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان المجرمين في ضلال وسعر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: truly the wicked are misguided and quite insane––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِي النَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا مَسَّ سَقَرَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم يسحبون في النار على وجوههم ذوقوا مس سقر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: on the Day when they are dragged on their faces in Hell. ‘Feel the touch of Hell.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَاهُ بِقَدَرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا كل شيء خلقناه بقدر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, all things We created with predestination
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have created all things in due measure

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةࣱ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا أَمْرُنَا إِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍ بِالْبَصَرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما امرنا الا واحدة كلمح بالبصر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when We ordain something it happens at once, in the blink of an eye

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد اهلكنا اشياعكم فهل من مدكر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have destroyed the likes of you in the past. Will anyone take heed

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءࣲ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِي الزُّبُرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وكل شيء فعلوه في الزبر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And everything they did is in written records
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Everything they do is noted in their records

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرࣲ وَكَبِيرࣲ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُسْتَطَرٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وكل صغير وكبير مستطر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: every action, great or small, is recorded

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَنَهَرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان المتقين في جنات ونهر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The righteous will live securely among Gardens and rivers

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكࣲ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فِي مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ مَلِيكٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: في مقعد صدق عند مليك مقتدر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: secure in the presence of an all-powerful Sovereign
